notes: Handwritten text leaf without a new author page number; thin bottom-left foliation 35 is retained as a margin number. The opening leaves injectivity without a characteristic assumption for further examination. The main paragraph returns to characteristic p and prime-to-p fundamental groups, with u read at both variable occurrences. It concludes u=0 for a torus and formulates a stronger lifting condition in the general case. The parenthetical on verra explicitly leaves part of the arithmetic proof pending; the manuscript’s literal question mark before the lifted p-torsion condition is retained as authorial ink, not an editorial uncertainty. The covering is written Y′ de X: X is clear and is not corrected to the mathematically tempting Y. The entire bottom isogeny attempt is cancelled, including its interlinear insertion; its words, isogeny label, terminal G/p and extra lower n remain explicitly doubtful. n_G is first in the label because the n is locally above the following G, not because multiplication notation is expected. The final live sentence says only that one might deduce P=Q. The oblique margin asserts persistence of theorem 2 in characteristic p for prime-to-p groups and discusses reduction to genus-zero curves; its phrase near on voit … près remains unresolved. The long marginal bracket is a separator/attachment feature, not a cancellation of the note. A short isolated dark slant above de genre 0 is recorded visually within its audit box and is not expanded into a word or formula. No diagrams, typescript, or formal mathematical verification occur on this leaf. lines_read counts main baselines, interlinear text and the marginal note approximately; every full-page/half-page element was inventoried. Main-reader targeted mathematical check 149_scan036_torus_p_primary_torsion: the torus conclusion u=0 is valid conditional on u having p-power order. Over an algebraic closure a torus is a product of multiplicative groups, and in characteristic p the equation z^(p^r)=1 implies (z−1)^(p^r)=0 and hence z=1. The preceding p-power-order assertion is not proved here. This supplied main-reader check supports the notes and no glyph choice.
